snippet.title: 1 ГИРЯ. 30 МИНУТ. ВСЁ ТЕЛО
snippet.description:
Один из моих любимых форматов тренировок, когда хочется за короткое время качественно нагрузить всё тело.

Минимум оборудования, высокая интенсивность и ничего лишнего.

Сам комплекс:

1. Выпады назад с диагональным переносом гири через голову – 8–10 на каждую ногу.
2. Выпады с жимом гири перед собой – 10–12 повторений.
3. Румынская тяга с гирей в одной руке – 10 на каждую сторону.
4. Сгибание рук с гирей и переносом через голову – 12 повторений.
5. Диагональный перенос гири через голову сидя – 10 на каждую сторону.
6. Отжимания узким хватом с опорой на гирю – 10–12 повторений.

Схема тренировки:

* 4 круга
* Отдых между упражнениями – 20–30 секунд
* Отдых между кругами – 60 секунд
* Общее время – около 30 минут

Подбирайте вес гири под свой уровень подготовки. Здесь важны не только интенсивность, но и контроль каждого движения.

Сохраняйте комплекс и пробуйте на следующей тренировке!

snippet.description:
【Judul】Apocalypto (2006)
【Sinopsis】Tak seorang pun pernah selamat dari permainan maut yang dibuat oleh sebuah suku, tetapi pria ini berhasil menghindari tombak dan panah hingga membuat kepala suku memimpin pengejaran untuk menangkapnya. Dia melarikan diri ke dalam hutan dan bersembunyi di atas pohon. Namun, saat mengira dirinya sudah aman, seekor kucing besar tiba-tiba muncul tepat di belakangnya dan memaksanya kembali berlari. Tanpa menyadari bahaya yang sebenarnya, para pengejar terus memburunya hingga salah satu dari mereka justru disergap oleh binatang buas tersebut. Saat berusaha menghindari panah, pria itu malah terperosok ke dalam lumpur hisap. Dengan tetap tenang, dia berhasil keluar sebelum para pengejarnya mendekat. Tak lama kemudian, dia menemukan sarang lebah dan melemparkannya ke arah para pengejar hingga mereka kocar-kacir. Namun, kali ini dia tidak ingin terus melarikan diri. Dia mengumpulkan katak beracun dan duri untuk membuat senjata tiup beracun, lalu bersembunyi menunggu musuh lewat. Ketika berhasil menyerang salah satu pengejar dari belakang, dia hampir mendapatkan senjata milik korbannya. Namun, seorang pengejar lain tiba-tiba berbalik menyerangnya. Setelah nyaris terkena sabetan senjata lawan, pria itu berhasil menghindar, merebut senjata tersebut, dan langsung melancarkan serangan balasan.

snippet.title: Can MOAB Destroy Iran’s Nuclear Sites?#iran #iranisraelwar #iranwar #nuclearenergy #nuclear #moab
snippet.description:
According to a CNN report, the US military has developed new strike options targeting Iran’s energy infrastructure and nuclear sites, potentially including the massive GBU-43/B MOAB, nicknamed the “Mother of All Bombs.” If President Donald Trump orders renewed military action, the reported plans could put this enormous conventional weapon in the spotlight.

Weighing around 9,800 kilograms, MOAB is designed to cause extensive blast damage over a large area. But it is not a specialised deep-penetration bunker-buster, meaning it may be ineffective against nuclear facilities buried deep underground beneath thick rock. Its use could also carry significant risks to civilians and surrounding infrastructure.

With diplomatic efforts uncertain and political pressure mounting ahead of the US midterm elections, the reported strike plans raise a critical question: would using MOAB create enough pressure to bring the conflict closer to an end, or risk triggering another dangerous escalation? Even a massive conventional bomb may not be enough to destroy deeply buried nuclear facilities.

The bigger issue is the facility’s location beneath a heavily buried granite mountain. That makes it extremely difficult to target with conventional weapons and could explain why Iran is investing in further hardening. If activity continues to increase, Pickaxe Mountain could become one of the most challenging potential targets in Iran’s nuclear infrastructure.

In Japan, snack packaging is taken seriously, especially when it comes to how the food looks compared to the picture on the box. From the shape and size to the colors and tiny details, companies are expected to represent their products accurately. 

Japan has strict rules against misleading advertising, meaning brands can face legal consequences if their packaging gives customers a false impression.
 
That's why some Japanese snacks look surprisingly similar to their package photos when you open them. Even the placement of chocolate chunks on a cookie can make the resemblance seem almost unbelievable!

snippet.title: Six Flags: Records reveal faulty restraints & broken bones
snippet.description:
In the years leading up to this week’s fatal accident at its Georgia theme park, Six Flags has been accused of failing to maintain its parks amid hundreds of reports of injuries and dangerous malfunctions on its aging thrill rides, according to a CNN analysis of public records and court filings.  

CNN's Kyung Lah has the details and CNN legal analyst Joey Jackson runs through the legal implications for Six Flags. Also, CNN's Isabel Rosales reports on the investigation into 42-year-old Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem's death while riding the Goliath rollercoaster at Six Flags Over Georgia.
